reading: Don Toliver postponed two London performances after his Manchester concert was evacuated on Sunday following the release of an unidentified substance into the audience.

Live Nation attributed the London disruption to a logistical constraint: the stage and production equipment remained in Manchester and could not be moved in time for Monday's O2 performance or Tuesday's Wembley Arena show.
Wembley Arena's replacement date is 14 December, while The O2 performance has been moved to 15 December.
Police said 89 people displayed symptoms believed to be linked to contact with the substance, and one person was taken to hospital.
Greater Manchester Police declared a major incident and said 12,000 people were evacuated from the arena.

A further 88 people underwent dry decontamination, a procedure for removing contamination without water, and were subsequently accommodated at the Etihad Stadium while the incident was managed, police said.
Fans described distressing scenes, while police initially suspected that the substance was tear gas.
Police were continuing to test items at the arena to identify the substance, and no arrests had been made.
Investigators were seeking to establish the substance's nature, its origin and any associated risk, according to Assistant Chief Constable Tom Harding.
The question of whether any criminality had occurred was also under investigation.
Some fans questioned security arrangements, complaining about a lack of searches as people entered the Manchester concert.
The arena was said to use frictionless screening that detected prohibited items without requiring people to empty their pockets.
Murray said many large venues used mass screening technology, and the report also described camera monitoring, security guards and plain-clothed officers at such venues.
Murray considered current technology adequate but argued that it needed to become more sophisticated over the next few years.
Venues were said to be concentrating on excluding items, such as explosives, that could cause mass casualties.
A statement said full refunds for the Manchester show would be processed automatically.

vocabulary.definition: A practical limitation involving the organisation or movement of people or resources.
A procedure for removing potentially harmful material from a person without using water.
Provided with a place to stay temporarily, without necessarily being given overnight lodging.
The possibility of harm connected with the substance or circumstances being investigated.
Conduct that constitutes a criminal offence, rather than merely causing concern or disruption.
Security checking designed to minimise interruptions or actions required from people passing through.
Objects that the applicable rules forbid people from bringing into a particular place.
Police officers wearing ordinary clothes rather than uniforms.
Technologically advanced and capable of performing more complex or precise tasks.
Large numbers of people killed or injured in an incident.

entries.ja: 人や資源の手配や移動に関わる、実務上の制約。
entries.ko: 사람이나 자원을 배치하거나 이동시키는 데 따르는 실무적인 제약.
entries.zh-Hans: 涉及人员或资源的组织安排或调动的实际限制。
entries.es: Una limitación práctica relacionada con la organización o el traslado de personas o recursos.
entries.pt-BR: Uma limitação prática relacionada à organização ou ao deslocamento de pessoas ou recursos.
entries.fr: Une limite pratique liée à l’organisation ou au déplacement de personnes ou de ressources.
entries.de: Eine praktische Einschränkung bei der Organisation oder Beförderung von Personen oder Ressourcen.

entries.ja: 水を使わずに、人の体から有害な可能性のある物質を取り除く処置。
entries.ko: 물을 사용하지 않고 사람의 몸에서 유해할 수 있는 물질을 제거하는 절차.
entries.zh-Hans: 不使用水，清除人体上可能有害的物质的处理程序。
entries.es: Un procedimiento para retirar de una persona material potencialmente dañino sin utilizar agua.
entries.pt-BR: Um procedimento para remover de uma pessoa material potencialmente nocivo, sem usar água.
entries.fr: Une procédure visant à retirer d’une personne des matières potentiellement nocives sans utiliser d’eau.
entries.de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem möglicherweise schädliche Stoffe ohne Wasser vom Körper einer Person entfernt werden.

entries.ja: 一時的に滞在できる場所を提供されたこと。ただし、必ずしも宿泊場所を与えられたわけではない。
entries.ko: 임시로 머물 장소를 제공받았으나, 반드시 하룻밤 묵을 숙소를 제공받은 것은 아님.
entries.zh-Hans: 获得了可供暂时停留的地方，但不一定获得了过夜的住宿安排。
entries.es: Se les proporcionó un lugar donde permanecer temporalmente, sin que necesariamente se les ofreciera alojamiento para pasar la noche.
entries.pt-BR: Receberam um lugar para ficar temporariamente, sem necessariamente terem recebido hospedagem para passar a noite.
entries.fr: Ont bénéficié d’un lieu où rester temporairement, sans nécessairement avoir reçu un hébergement pour la nuit.
entries.de: Haben einen Ort für einen vorübergehenden Aufenthalt erhalten, ohne dass ihnen unbedingt eine Übernachtungsmöglichkeit angeboten wurde.

entries.ja: 調査中の物質や状況に関連して、危害が生じる可能性。
entries.ko: 조사 중인 물질이나 상황과 관련하여 피해가 발생할 가능성.
entries.zh-Hans: 与正在调查的物质或情况有关的、造成伤害的可能性。
entries.es: La posibilidad de que se produzcan daños relacionados con la sustancia o las circunstancias que se están investigando.
entries.pt-BR: A possibilidade de ocorrerem danos relacionados à substância ou às circunstâncias que estão sendo investigadas.
entries.fr: La possibilité de dommages liés à la substance ou aux circonstances faisant l’objet de l’enquête.
entries.de: Die Möglichkeit eines Schadens im Zusammenhang mit dem untersuchten Stoff oder den untersuchten Umständen.

entries.ja: 単に懸念や混乱を引き起こすだけでなく、犯罪に当たる行為。
entries.ko: 단순히 우려나 혼란을 일으키는 데 그치지 않고 범죄에 해당하는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 构成刑事犯罪的行为，而不仅仅是引起担忧或造成混乱的行为。
entries.es: Una conducta que constituye un delito, en lugar de limitarse a causar preocupación o alteraciones.
entries.pt-BR: Uma conduta que constitui um crime, em vez de apenas causar preocupação ou transtornos.
entries.fr: Un comportement qui constitue une infraction pénale, au-delà du simple fait de susciter des inquiétudes ou de provoquer des perturbations.
entries.de: Ein Verhalten, das eine Straftat darstellt und nicht lediglich Besorgnis oder Störungen verursacht.

entries.ja: 通過する人の流れを妨げたり、その人に何らかの動作を求めたりすることを最小限に抑えるよう設計された保安検査。
entries.ko: 통과하는 사람들이 겪는 지연이나 해야 할 행동을 최소화하도록 설계된 보안 검색.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在尽量减少对通行人员的阻碍或需要他们配合完成的操作的安全检查。
entries.es: Un control de seguridad diseñado para reducir al mínimo las interrupciones o las acciones que deben realizar las personas que pasan por él.
entries.pt-BR: Uma verificação de segurança planejada para minimizar as interrupções ou as ações exigidas das pessoas que passam por ela.
entries.fr: Un contrôle de sécurité conçu pour réduire au minimum les interruptions ou les gestes demandés aux personnes qui le passent.
entries.de: Eine Sicherheitskontrolle, die so gestaltet ist, dass Personen beim Passieren möglichst wenig aufgehalten werden oder selbst tun müssen.

entries.ja: 適用される規則により、特定の場所への持ち込みが禁止されている物品。
entries.ko: 해당 장소에 적용되는 규정에 따라 반입이 금지된 물건.
entries.zh-Hans: 适用规则禁止人们带入某个特定场所的物品。
entries.es: Objetos que las normas aplicables prohíben introducir en un lugar determinado.
entries.pt-BR: Objetos que as regras aplicáveis proíbem as pessoas de levar para determinado local.
entries.fr: Des objets que les règles en vigueur interdisent d’introduire dans un lieu donné.
entries.de: Gegenstände, die nach den geltenden Regeln nicht an einen bestimmten Ort mitgebracht werden dürfen.

entries.ja: 制服ではなく普段着を着ている警察官。
entries.zh-Hans: 穿着日常服装而非制服的警察。
entries.es: Agentes de policía que visten ropa habitual en lugar de uniforme.
entries.pt-BR: Policiais que usam roupas comuns em vez de uniforme.
entries.fr: Des policiers portant des vêtements ordinaires plutôt qu’un uniforme.
entries.de: Polizeikräfte, die gewöhnliche Kleidung statt einer Uniform tragen.

entries.ja: 技術的に進んでおり、より複雑な作業や、より精密さを要する作業を行えること。
entries.ko: 기술적으로 발전하여 더 복잡하거나 더 높은 정밀도가 필요한 작업을 수행할 수 있음을 뜻함.
entries.zh-Hans: 技术先进，能够执行更复杂或更精细的任务。
entries.es: Tecnológicamente avanzado y capaz de realizar tareas más complejas o que requieren mayor precisión.
entries.pt-BR: Tecnologicamente avançado e capaz de realizar tarefas mais complexas ou que exigem maior precisão.
entries.fr: D’un niveau technologique avancé et capable d’accomplir des tâches plus complexes ou exigeant davantage de précision.
entries.de: Technologisch fortschrittlich und in der Lage, komplexere Aufgaben oder Aufgaben mit höheren Genauigkeitsanforderungen auszuführen.

entries.ja: ある出来事で死亡したり負傷したりした多数の人々。
entries.ko: 어떤 사건에서 사망하거나 다친 많은 수의 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 在一起事件中死亡或受伤的大量人员。
entries.es: Un gran número de personas muertas o heridas en un incidente.
entries.pt-BR: Um grande número de pessoas mortas ou feridas em um incidente.
entries.fr: Un grand nombre de personnes tuées ou blessées lors d’un incident.
entries.de: Eine große Zahl von Menschen, die bei einem Vorfall getötet oder verletzt werden.
